worker: lock`. It still sorts a copy (`[...packets]`), and the doc comment now says ordering is by session clock.
- **`src/telemetry/order.test.js`:** I added a shuffled wrap-straddling batch (seq 65534, 65535, 0, 1) that expects laps `[1, 2, 3, 4]`. I also renamed the existing test to "orders packets by session clock"; its assertion is unchanged.
- **`src/telemetry/state.test.js` (new):** it applies a wrap-straddling batch for two cars through `applyBatch(emptyState(), batch)`. It expects car 1 to get laps `[1, 2, 3, 4]` and car 2 to get `[11, 12, 13]`.

`git diff --stat` shows only those three files, so `packet.js`, `state.js` and `src/strategy/` are untouched. The existing pace test still passes.
